findings.title: Node.js Adapter for Hono path traversal in serve-static on Windows via encoded backslash
findings.platformScope: The underlying advisory concerns Windows path handling in @hono/node-server serve-static.
findings.boundary: The shadcn CLI is a pinned development-only registry inspection tool in the isolated Spike and must not ship in a generated application runtime.
findings.action: Monitor for a compatible shadcn release that resolves the transitive chain; retain isolation and do not apply npm audit's incompatible downgrade suggestion automatically.

selectionImpact: The finding is not an application-runtime vulnerability in this Spike, but it remains a supply-chain maintenance cost for the shadcn registry workflow and must be represented in the final weighted comparison.
